environment.hardware_qualification: Unqualified execution host; CPU/SSD target hardware not verified.

provider_configuration: None; local deterministic operations only. No network, no model.

definitions.recall@k: Share of a query's relevant locators covered by at least one of the top k hits (hit and locator overlap).
definitions.ndcg@10: Binary gain per hit that newly covers a relevant locator; ideal list is min(locators, 10) gains.
definitions.mrr: Reciprocal rank of the first hit overlapping any relevant locator within the top 20; 0 when none.
definitions.latency_ms: Wall time of one search call per query after one untimed warm-up; nearest-rank percentiles. latency_cpu_ms is the process CPU time of the same calls (the host was shared with other jobs: see the load averages).
definitions.index_bytes: Size of the derived SQLite index after a WAL checkpoint, including stored vectors.
definitions.build_seconds: LibraryIndex.refresh from an empty cache (parsing, chunking, FTS). prepare_seconds adds embedding.
definitions.absence: literal probes count as found when any hit overlaps a labelled occurrence; expected-absent probes report whether the engine returned nothing (a lexical OR search never does: semantic absence is reported separately).

not_measured: Reference-laptop latency: this host is not a qualified reference machine.
Model-backed embeddings, reranking and entailment (hybrid-fake uses a hashing function, not a model).
Cross-library queries from webclips into the novels and papers.
note: Hybrid search with the on-device Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B int8 model (local ONNX, no network) on the fast sample subsets, every covered golden query. The full libraries (about 3,900 merged chunks at roughly 1.8 s each) were too slow for this host.
